scenes.script: Your disk is full, and you do not know why. Do not guess, and do not delete yet. Three short commands will tell you.
The plan is simple. First measure every folder, then sort the sizes, then keep the largest five.
Open a terminal in your home folder and type this line. The du command measures each folder, and prints one short size for each.
Now send the result through sort, and keep only the last five lines with tail.

card.label: terminal
card.text:
$ du -sh * | sort -h | tail -5
96M   Music
340M  Photos
1.2G  Videos

scenes.script: Save the line as a small script, so next time it is one word.
Run it in any folder that feels heavy. And delete only what you know you can lose.
